items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: It’s like Scott Hamilton when he first came out, he was just 40 pounds dripping wet.

ctx.x: Yes, isn’t it? And he gets up and the horn sort of dwarfs him.
It’s like Scott Hamilton when he first came out, he was just 40 pounds dripping wet. And that horn was bigger than he was.
You know who else was a nice person in the band, Danny Turner, who also just recently passed away. Did you know Danny?
